title: Avoid exact registration-query refusal for unrelated registration metadata updates
outcome: The new exact-query content fence compares the entire TestRunRegistration row plus its durable bit. An unrelated metadata update during canonicalization can return409 after a durable ACK, and the current launcher treats a failed confirmation GET as definitive no-start. Evaluate an identity-scoped fence or a bounded server-side recapture without loosening locator/run/digest/owner/start/durability correctness.
acceptance: A deterministic unrelated-metadata update during the off-lock check does not unnecessarily abort an otherwise exact durable confirmation, or the chosen contract explicitly handles a bounded retry.
Locator, run identity, request digest, owner, start or durability changes cannot select a stale indexed entry; coverage distinguishes these changes from unrelated metadata.
